AVP / VP – Brand, Marketing & Corporate Communications | GTM | Digital & Customer Engagement | Leadership Communications Mumbai, India | roopali.dayal@gmail.com | +91 9898224167/9004652227

PROFILE SUMMARY

Senior Marketing, Brand & Corporate Communications leader with 16+ years of experience driving brand strategy, digital presence, content marketing, go-to-market execution, customer engagement, and enterprise communications across BFSI, Pharma, and regulated global environments.

Proven track record in building compelling brand narratives, managing corporate websites and digital content ecosystems, leading thought leadership initiatives, developing marketing collateral, and creating market-facing communication to support business growth and stakeholder engagement.

Trusted advisor to CXOs and business leaders in translating complex products, services, and transformation programs into compelling customer-facing, employee-facing, and market-facing narratives. Experienced in leading large-scale brand transitions, merger communications, agency ecosystems, and cross-functional teams while delivering measurable outcomes in engagement, adoption, visibility, and operational efficiency.

Experience spanning domestic and international markets including US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, with expertise in content strategy, website governance, brand management, customer communication, leadership communication, and marketing operations.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Brand Strategy & Corporate Positioning • Marketing Communications & Content Strategy • Digital Presence & Website Governance • Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy & Product Communication • Digital & Multi-Channel Customer Engagement • Customer Engagement & Lifecycle Marketing • Thought Leadership & Business Development Communication • Internal Communications & Change Management • Brand Transition, Merger & Integration Communication • Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership • Data-Driven Communication & Performance Optimization • Employer Branding & Employee Engagement

AU SMALL FINANCE BANK

Assistant Vice President – Product Marketing & Customer Communication Mumbai | Sep 2024 – July 2025

Drove go-to-market communication strategy for digital banking propositions, aligning positioning, messaging, and channel strategy with product and business objectives

Developed customer communication strategy, segmentation, messaging frameworks and multi-channel customer journeys across banking portfolios, including liabilities, assets, forex, wealth and ETB/NTB customer cohorts, driving customer engagement, product adoption and business growth

Designed and executed multi-channel communication strategy across SMS, email, in-app, ATM, and digital platforms to drive customer engagement and digital adoption

Partnered with product, digital, technology, and design teams to drive feature launches, digital adoption, customer education, and content optimization across customer-facing platforms. Key Responsibilities & Impact:

Developed and executed integrated marketing and corporate communication strategies across global B2B markets, supporting client acquisition, business development, brand positioning, thought leadership, and market visibility initiatives.

Built brand narratives, messaging frameworks, and content architecture tailored for



international clients across regulated markets (US, EU, SEA, Middle East) Led development of capability presentations, pursuit material, executive communication, and technical content supporting business development, client acquisition, and stakeholder engagement across US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Middle East markets.

Developed corporate website content, service narratives, company profiles, and thought leadership programs that strengthened brand positioning, enhanced market visibility, and supported global client engagement initiatives.

Managed leadership and external communication, authoring articles, interviews, Q&As and thought leadership content for global visibility.

Coordinated with PR agencies, publication platforms, and international stakeholders, ensuring high-quality editorial output and compliance-driven messaging

Delivered award-winning submissions and global recognition initiatives, contributing to multiple national and international accolades

Supported employer branding and internal communication initiatives, strengthening organizational positioning and employee engagement

Enabled global brand visibility and business growth through industry events, international conferences, and publications.

Delivered 33% growth in UPI bill payments through strategic customer communication



optimization Led communication and brand integration strategy for the AU–Fincare merger, ensuring seamless customer transition and uninterrupted business continuity
